newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt extends deadline for BOT container terminal.
newsitem.headline: Egypt extends deadline for BOT container terminal.

text.p: Egypt on Wednesday extended until April 13 the deadline for bids to build and run a container terminal in the Red Sea province of Suez under a BOT (build, operate, transfer) system. The original deadline was March 6.
The state's General Authority for Red Sea Ports (GARSP) says the terminal would be at Adabiya port at the southern mouth of the Suez Canal.
The terminal includes quays 600 metres (2,000 feet) long and 15 metres (49 feet) deep and a storage area of 400,000 square metres (4.3 million square feet), it added.
The length of the quays may be extended to 1,000 metres (3,280 feet). The terminal "enjoys a unique location in Adabiya port and looks at Asia and Africa," GARSP said.
The preliminary cost is expected to be 200 million pounds ($59 million), it has said.
Egypt, facing tough competition from other regional traffic routes and declining Suez Canal revenues, is trying to build new free zones in Sinai and around the canal.
